nodes.name: Outreach inbox (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Credentials live in n8n only: host imap.hostinger.com, port 993, SSL/TLS on, user = the outreach address, password = its mailbox password.

nodes.name: Sign (HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.notes: Secret = the Worker's N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Either set CRMA_WEBHOOK_SECRET in n8n's environment or paste the secret here instead of the expression.
